text: A vehicle taken from series production shall not exhibit any degradation relating to the direct control of the vehicle that could be observed by the driver or other road users when in the state defined in Annex 6, paragraph 4., and subjected to a field strength, expressed in V/m, up to 80 per cent of the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 6.4.2.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.7.2.1.

text: Where applicable, an ESA taken from series production shall not exhibit any degradation relating to the direct control of the vehicle that could be observed by the driver or other road users when subjected to a field strength, expressed in V/m, up to 80 per cent of the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 7.18.2.1.
verbatim_quote: paragraph 6.8.2.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.18.2.1. for ESAs above
why_distinct: The existing requirement references only the 6.8.2.1 limits; the conditionally applicable 7.18.2.1 reference limits for ESAs are a different test condition.

text: Where applicable (e.g. components/STUs connected to the power grid in charging mode), a component/STU taken from series production shall show no degradation of performance of its immunity-related functions up to the conducted disturbance immunity levels given in paragraph 7.19.1.

why_distinct: Paragraph 7.19.1 covers a separate, conditional immunity limit set, distinct from 6.9.1. The existing R-0029 covers only 6.9.1.

text: Where applicable (e.g. components/STUs connected to the power grid in charging mode), a component/STU taken from series production shall not exceed the conducted emission levels given in paragraph 7.17.1.

why_distinct: Paragraph 7.17.1 is a separate, conditional emission limit set, distinct from 6.7.1. The existing R-0030 covers only 6.7.1.

text: If a rear end-outline marker lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp (steady or variable luminous intensity), the ratio between the luminous intensities measured with both lamps turned on simultaneously and the intensity of the rear end-outline marker lamp turned on alone shall be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by ±5° V and ±10° H of the light distribution table. text: Where the complete interdependent lamp system is mounted on the moving component(s), additional lamps for these functions may be switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position. These additional lamps shall satisfy all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
verbatim_quote: However, additional lamps for the above functions may be switched ON, when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component
why_distinct: R-0330 covers only the base requirement of option (a). The conditional allowance for additional lamps, with its own compliance criteria, is not covered.

text: Where direction indicator lamps form an interdependent lamp system mounted partly on the fixed component and partly on a movable component, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during device approval shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, photometric and colorimetric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
verbatim_quote: For direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, photometric and colorimetric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
why_distinct: Direction indicator lamps are a separate category. They must meet the full geometric visibility requirement rather than outward visibility only, with no photometric deeming for inward visibility. No existing requirement covers them.

text: For direction indicator lamps in a partly fixed/partly movable interdependent lamp system, additional lamps may be switched ON to fulfil or complete the geometric visibility angle when the movable component is in any fixed open position. These additional lamps shall satisfy all the position, photometric and colorimetric requirements applicable to the direction indicator lamps installed on the movable component.
verbatim_quote: This does not apply where, to fulfil or complete the geometric visibility angle, additional lamps are switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, photometric and colorimetric requirements applicable to the direction indicator lamps installed on the movable component.
why_distinct: This is a distinct exception for direction indicators that sets its own conditions for additional lamps. None of the existing requirements address it.

text: For dipped-beam headlamps and front fog lamps on a movable component, the return-to-position requirement is satisfied if, after the movable component is moved and returned to the normal position 10 times, no angular inclination value of the lamp relative to its support, measured after each operation, differs by more than 0.15 per cent from the average of the 10 measured values.
verbatim_quote: In the case of dipped-beam headlamps and front fog lamps, this requirement shall be considered satisfied if, when the movable components are moved and returned to the normal position 10 times, no value of the angular inclination of these lamps, relative to its support, measured after each operation of the movable component, differs by more than 0.15 per cent from the average of the 10 measured values.
why_distinct: Specific quantitative pass/fail criterion (0.15% deviation over 10 cycles) for dipped-beam headlamps and front fog lamps, not expressed in R-0273's general return requirement.

text: If the 0.15 per cent deviation is exceeded, each inclination limit specified in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. shall be modified by the excess so as to decrease the allowed range of inclinations when checking the vehicle according to Annex 6.
verbatim_quote: If this value is exceeded each limit specified in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. shall then be modified by this excess to decrease the allowed range of inclinations when checking the vehicle according to Annex 6.
why_distinct: Separate consequential obligation (tightening of inclination limits by the excess) applying when the 0.15% criterion is exceeded; not covered by any existing requirement.

text: In case rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b have variable luminous intensity control and are combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated with rear position lamps (R2) and/or stop lamps (S2), the intensity of all these lamps shall vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
verbatim_quote: Rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control ... (a) The intensity of the all lamps mentioned above, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
why_distinct: R-0279 covers only R2 and S2 lamps; the paragraph also explicitly applies obligation (a) to category 2b rear direction indicator lamps, which no existing requirement mentions.

text: Any method used to measure variations of inclination shall give readings accurate to within ±0.2 mrad (±0.02 per cent inclination).
verbatim_quote: Any method may be used to measure variations of inclination provided that the readings are accurate to within ±0.2 mrad (±0.02 per cent inclination).
why_distinct: Neither existing requirement covers this paragraph's only obligation, the ±0.2 mrad accuracy limit for inclination measurements. Both extracted requirements concern lamp reference-axis alignment and fitting instructions. Including it is a judgement call, because a measurement-accuracy limit is close to the test-procedure content that is meant to be excluded.

text: If only one of the calculated upper or lower limits of variation of the dipped-beam inclination is exceeded, the manufacturer shall be permitted to choose a different value for the stated initial inclination, provided it remains within the limits specified for approval.
verbatim_quote: If only one of the calculated upper or lower limits of variation is exceeded, the manufacturer shall be permitted to choose a different value for the stated initial inclination, within the limits specified for approval.
why_distinct: Neither existing requirement covers this. Both concern logos, which this paragraph does not mention. This sentence sets a distinct condition: only one variation limit is exceeded, and the new initial inclination must stay within the approval limits.

text: When a front position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with it, the colour requirements of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front position lamp are switched ON.
verbatim_quote: However, when a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.
why_distinct: R-0256 covers only the rear position lamp; the paragraph also imposes the same colour obligation on functions reciprocally incorporated with a front position lamp, which is a separate lamp category and test condition.

text: Option (a): For a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1.(a) whose apparent surface is composed of two or more distinct parts, the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis, shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing that projection. This requirement does not apply to a single retro-reflector.
verbatim_quote: (a) Either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis
why_distinct: List item (a) is a distinct test condition (an area ratio of at least 60 per cent of the circumscribing quadrilateral). The existing requirement bundles it with item (b).

text: Option (b): For a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1.(a) whose apparent surface is composed of two or more distinct parts, the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm, measured perpendicularly to the reference axis. This requirement does not apply to a single retro-reflector.
verbatim_quote: (b) The minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
why_distinct: List item (b) is a separate test condition (a maximum edge-to-edge distance of 75 mm). The existing requirement bundles it with item (a).

text: Single lamps composed of two independent retro reflectors (paragraph 2.4.11.1. (b) or (c)) shall be installed such that either the projection of the apparent surfaces of the two retro reflectors in the direction of the reference axis occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing those projections, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of the apparent surfaces of the two independent retro reflectors does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
verbatim_quote: composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, shall be installed in such a way that
why_distinct: R-0258 covers only assemblies of two lamps marked 'D'. The paragraph applies the same installation obligation separately to single lamps made of two independent retro reflectors, a different device category that has no requirement of its own.

text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
verbatim_quote: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
why_distinct: The existing requirement covers interdependent lamp systems marked 'Y'. This one applies to a different device category, single lamps per 2.4.11.1.(d), and is not expressed by R-0259.

text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary in relation to the ambient light, provided that any such variation complies with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
verbatim_quote: (a) In relation to the ambient light;
why_distinct: List item (a) is a distinct permitted variation condition (ambient light). R-0261 bundles all three items without a dedicated requirement for this one.

text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, provided that any such variation complies with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
verbatim_quote: (b) As a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF;
why_distinct: List item (b) is a distinct permitted variation condition (other lamps switched ON/OFF). R-0261 bundles it with the other items.

text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, provided that any such variation complies with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
verbatim_quote: (c) When the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function;
why_distinct: List item (c) is a distinct permitted variation condition (use for another lighting function). R-0261 bundles it with the other items.

text: For vehicles of categories other than M1 and N1, the distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces of the rear position lamps in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm.
verbatim_quote: For all other categories of vehicles: be not less than 600 mm.
why_distinct: This is a separate lateral-separation requirement between the two lamps' inner edges, applying only to categories other than M1/N1. R-0307 covers only the outer-edge 400 mm limit.

text: For vehicles of categories other than M1 and N1 whose overall width is less than 1,300 mm, the distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes may be reduced to not less than 400 mm.
verbatim_quote: This distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
why_distinct: This is a different pass/fail limit (400 mm instead of 600 mm) for a distinct vehicle-width condition, so it is a separate test condition.

text: The vertical angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be 15° above and below the horizontal.
verbatim_quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal.
why_distinct: Vertical direction is a separate requirement from the horizontal angle under the direction rule; R-0310 bundles both directions.

text: Where a rear position lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward vertical angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
verbatim_quote: (a) Where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°;
why_distinct: Lettered list item (a) is a distinct condition and is bundled into R-0310 rather than stated on its own.

text: Where an optional rear position lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the upward vertical angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
verbatim_quote: (b) Where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
why_distinct: Lettered list item (b) is not covered at all by R-0310, which omits the upward-angle reduction for optional lamps mounted above 2,100 mm.

text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles using the alternative visibility of paragraph 6.10.5.2 (only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed), the rear position lamp shall have a vertical geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
verbatim_quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
why_distinct: R-0311 bundles the horizontal and vertical visibility angles into one requirement. Under the direction rule, the vertical angle and its 750 mm downward-angle reduction are a separate test condition.

text: For N1 vehicles, the point on the apparent surface of the S1 or S2 stop lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
verbatim_quote: For M1 and N1 category vehicles: For S1 or S2 categories devices that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle
why_distinct: The existing requirement covers only M1; the N1 vehicle category variant is not expressed.

text: For vehicle categories other than M1 and N1, the distance between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces of S1 or S2 stop lamps in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm.
verbatim_quote: For all other categories of vehicles: For S1 or S2 categories devices the distance in between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm.
why_distinct: A different vehicle category with a different criterion (minimum inner-edge separation).

text: For vehicle categories other than M1 and N1 with an overall width of less than 1,300 mm, the distance between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces of S1 or S2 stop lamps may be reduced to not less than 400 mm.
verbatim_quote: This distance may be reduced to 400 mm if the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
why_distinct: A distinct condition (narrow vehicles) with a different numerical limit.

text: For S3 or S4 category stop lamps, the centre of reference shall be situated on the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.
verbatim_quote: For S3 or S4 category devices: the centre of reference shall be situated on the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.
why_distinct: A different device category with its own positional requirement.

text: Where two S3 or S4 category devices are installed according to paragraph 6.7.2., they shall be positioned as close as possible to the median longitudinal plane, one on each side of this plane.
verbatim_quote: However, in the case where the two devices of the S3 or S4 category are installed, according to paragraph 6.7.2., they shall be positioned as close as possible to the median longitudinal plane, one on each side of this plane.
why_distinct: A distinct condition for the two-device S3/S4 installation case.

text: Where one S3 or S4 category lamp offset from the median longitudinal plane is permitted according to paragraph 6.7.2., the offset shall not exceed 150 mm from the median longitudinal plane to the centre of reference of the lamp.
verbatim_quote: In the case where one S3 or S4 category lamp offset from the median longitudinal plane is permitted according to paragraph 6.7.2., this offset shall not exceed 150 mm from the median longitudinal plane to the centre of reference of the lamp.
why_distinct: A distinct condition for an offset single S3/S4 lamp, with a specific 150 mm limit.

text: Stop lamps of category S3 or S4 shall have a horizontal geometric visibility angle of 10° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.
verbatim_quote: For S3 or S4 categories devices: 10° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle
why_distinct: Different device category (S3/S4) with a different horizontal angle; the existing requirement covers only S1/S2.

text: Stop lamps of category S3 or S4 shall have a vertical geometric visibility angle of 10° above and 5° below the horizontal.
verbatim_quote: For S3 or S4 categories devices: 10° above and 5° below the horizontal.
why_distinct: Vertical direction for the S3/S4 category, with different pass/fail angles; not covered by the existing requirement.

text: For S1 or S2 stop lamps, where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the upward vertical visibility angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
verbatim_quote: (b) Where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
why_distinct: Lettered list item (b), a distinct mounting-height condition and relaxation; it is absent from the existing requirement.

text: Stop lamps of category S1 or S2 shall have a vertical geometric visibility angle of 15° above and below the horizontal; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm, the downward angle may be reduced to 5°.
verbatim_quote: Vertical angle: For S1 or S2 categories devices: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, (a) Where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°
why_distinct: Under the direction rule, the vertical requirement for S1/S2 (with list item (a)) is separate from the horizontal requirement, which the existing requirement bundles together.
